paper_metadata.title: A 1.8-V MOSFET-Only Modulator Using Substrate Biased Depletion-Mode MOS Capacitors in Series Compensation
paper_metadata.abstract: A low-voltage high-linearity MOSFET-only modulator for speech band applications is presented. The modulator uses substrate biased MOSFETs in the depletion region as capacitors, linearized by a series compensation technique. A second-order fully differential single-loop architecture has been realized in a conventional 0.25m digital n-well CMOS process without extra layers for capacitors. An SNDR of 72 dB and an SNR of 77 dB is obtained with 8-kHz signal bandwidth at an oversampling ratio of 64. The circuit consumes about 1 mW from a single 1.8-V power supply and occupies a core area of 0.08 mm2.
